Subject: Contract and fees
Date: Monday 28 September 2026
From: Dom Selvon <dom@valliance.ai>
To: Imogen Fairlie <imogen.fairlie@wyndhamretail.example.test>

Imogen,

Your legal team has been quick, which I appreciate.

I will send the redlined contract this afternoon and the revised fee schedule by Friday.

Best,
Dom
